courses.title: Servant Leadership
courses.summary: Jesus defined greatness as serving. Leaders go first in humility.
courses.assignment: Serve someone in your group this week without being asked, then reflect on what you learned.

courses.title: Biblical Leadership
courses.summary: Character before skill: what Scripture asks of those who lead God's people.
courses.assignment: Read 1 Timothy 3 with a mentor and choose one area of character to work on.

courses.title: Paul's Leadership
courses.summary: How Paul trained others, entrusted responsibility and kept going through hardship.
courses.assignment: Map Paul's 2 Timothy 2:2 chain onto your own life: who taught you, and whom will you teach?

courses.title: Communication
courses.summary: Listening well, speaking clearly and communicating across languages.
courses.assignment: Give a 5-minute talk to your small group and ask for two pieces of feedback.

courses.title: Counseling Basics
courses.summary: Caring listening, and knowing when to refer someone to a pastor or professional.
courses.assignment: Practice active listening in one conversation. Write down what you heard, not what you said.

courses.title: Mentoring
courses.summary: Walking with one person over time, the heart of multiplication.
courses.assignment: Meet with one younger believer three times this month.

courses.title: Small Group Leadership
courses.summary: Planning a meeting, asking good questions and caring for members.
courses.assignment: Co-lead one small group session with an experienced leader.

courses.title: Teaching the Bible
courses.summary: Reading a passage carefully, explaining it simply and applying it.
courses.assignment: Prepare and teach a 15-minute Bible study on a short passage.

courses.title: Leading in Evangelism
courses.summary: Sharing the gospel personally and training others to do the same.
courses.assignment: Share your story of faith with one person and then train a friend to share theirs.

courses.title: Conflict Management
courses.summary: Handling disagreement biblically, quickly and with grace.
courses.assignment: Study Matthew 18:15–17 and role-play a difficult conversation with your mentor.

courses.title: Cross-cultural Ministry
courses.summary: Ministering among Filipinos, Koreans and other nationalities with understanding.
courses.assignment: Interview someone from another culture about how they see faith and community.

courses.title: Digital Ministry Leadership
courses.summary: Leading online groups and content teams responsibly.
courses.assignment: Plan and host one online Bible study using Zoom or Messenger.
